geometry_edits.rationale: Replace the stepped hall section logic with a monitor roof expression that better supports gym daylight and span legibility.
Keep the hall organized as one dominant long-span volume along the x axis.
Reduce the void margin to sharpen the public threshold and avoid over-cutting the hall body.

graph_edits.rationale: Shift the protected section macro away from a stepped/cascading roof read toward a clearer long-span gym section.
A monitor/daylight roof family better matches the gymnasium roof-section invariant than the current stepped profile.
Preserve the hall as one clear long-span body along the dominant axis.
Tighten and clarify the carved void so it reads more like an entry/court threshold and less like a generic internal notch.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent four-view object, but its dominant read is an abstract folded/courtyard block rather than a legible long-span gymnasium. The central void is present and gives some ground relief, yet it does not clearly resolve into a public entry, court, or service threshold on the verified frontage. The massing is over-determined by intersecting planes and stepped folds, which weakens the hall logic and makes the roof/section read more like an arbitrary sculptural cap than span or daylight expression. It is not incoherent enough to fail as geometry, but it fails the program contract because the gymnasium’s clear-span dominant hall and subordinate service hierarchy are not convincingly visible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More expressive club composition than a clear gym hall; the candidate is much more closed and internally folded.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long-span sports massing can be softened by a protected edge and a readable public-facing ground zone.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Candidate lacks the long horizontal clarity and open perimeter of the reference.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Linear hall datum with a subordinate service/entry strip and a strong roof edge suits the gym brief.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more infrastructural/interior-court than the candidate’s compact folded mass.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Carved court/void condition can organize circulation and public entry at ground level.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate’s void is more central and ambiguous, with weaker access legibility.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: As a counterfactual, it warns against overcomplicated sectional massing; it is not a direct compositional model for the candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Use a restrained hall-and-base hierarchy with a clear public frontage rather than sculptural folding.

warnings: Visible four-view coherence is acceptable, but the building reads as a folded compact object rather than a gym hall.
The central void is semantically weak as public access from the frontage edge.
Roof/section expression does not clearly communicate clear-span structure or daylight logic.
No parcel boundary was provided as a visible green polygon in the candidate image, so parcel containment could not be evaluated here.
